title: Structured block authoring

story.need: create pages and compose them from a governed catalog of reusable blocks
story.outcome: build a structured website without deriving each page from first principles

scope: Create a page as an unpublished draft
Validate blocks against a versioned block catalog
Add, edit, reorder, and remove supported blocks
Search and filter the page list
Render every supported block on public and preview routes
dataRequirements: Every block has a stable identifier, catalog type, and schema version
Page paths are unique per site
Unsupported block data is rejected before persistence
Block order is represented by document order
permissions: Only authenticated editors may create or change drafts
Anonymous visitors can read only published revisions

acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated editor on the page list
then: an unpublished revision one is stored
the editor opens for the new page

acceptanceCriteria.given: a page draft and the block catalog
acceptanceCriteria.when: the editor composes and saves supported blocks
then: the complete document passes catalog validation
block identifiers and order are preserved

acceptanceCriteria.when: another page attempts to use it
then: the mutation is rejected as a path conflict

acceptanceCriteria.given: a published page at any supported path
acceptanceCriteria.when: an anonymous visitor requests the path
then: every block uses its catalog renderer
